description: WPILib's SystemCore (the FRC 2027 robot controller, Limelight OS), read without credentials. Recognised by its own API on port 4800 (/api/team) and keyed by team: the same unit over its USB link (172.27.0.1, 172.26.0.1 on Windows) and at .2 on the robot network is one device. Atlas's code adds what this can't say: its versions and package installs by SSH key (opkg), its USB link checks, Atlas's USB agent on it and the boards behind it (crates/atlas-driver-robot/src/systemcore.rs).
